question: Choose the correctly spelt word:
solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. Millionaire .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling of the word is **"Millionaire"**, which refers to a person whose wealth is equal to or exceeds one million units of currency.
 
• Option 1 (**Millionire**), Option 3 (**Millioner**), and Option 4 (**Millionair**) are incorrect as they are misspelled and do not conform to standard English usage.
 
• To verify the spelling, one may refer to authoritative dictionaries such as the Oxford English Dictionary or Merriam-Webster Dictionary.

Correct spelling: *Millionaire*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Word Origin:**
 
 
• The word **Millionaire** is derived from the French term *millionaire*, which is based on the word *million*.
 
• It was first used in the early 19th century to describe individuals with substantial wealth.
 
 
 
• **Example Usage:**
 
 
• He became a **millionaire** after his company was acquired by a large corporation.
 
• Many people aspire to become **millionaires** by working hard and investing wisely.
